title: Introduction to LLM-based software engineering
summary: Role of LLMs in the software development lifecycle - coding assistants - testing and debugging support - documentation and review - limitations of LLM outputs - academic integrity and responsible use. Prompting as interface design: Role and task specification - constraints and acceptance criteria - input/output formatting - structured prompting - prompt refinement for software tasks - prompt reuse as configuration artifact. LLMs as software components: LLM APIs - request/response patterns - context handling - conversation state - output parsing - schema-based validation - error handling and retries. Structured outputs and integration: JSON outputs - lightweight schemas - deterministic wrappers - validation before execution - integration into software pipelines. From assistants to agents: Chatbots versus agents - perceive-think- act-observe loop - tool use - simple state handling - single-agent task execution. Tools and tool registries: Function/tool calling - tool abstraction - file, search, and execution tools - schemas for tools - permissions and scope control. Agent harness engineering: Harness definition - bounded execution - step limits - runtime policies - trace logging - human-in-the-loop approvals - failure handling and recovery. Agentic workflow patterns: ReAct-style loops - planner-executor pattern - retrieval-assisted workflows - choosing the simplest effective orchestration pattern. Evaluation harnesses: Task suites - success criteria - regression testing - step count, latency, and error metrics - qualitative evaluation - LLM-as-judge and rubric-based assessment. Observability and debugging: Trajectories and traces - prompt/tool/output inspection - episode logging - failure attribution - improving prompts, tools, and harness settings from evidence. Safety and governance: Prompt injection overview - unsafe tool use - privacy and data leakage risks - permission design - sandboxing - human review for high -impact actions. Capstone development and review: Team project planning - design of an LLM-integrated or agentic system - implementation with runtime harness and evaluation harness - demo and technical reflection
